chapters.label: The Bernabéu, 2009
chapters.text: The Bernabéu, 2009: Real Madrid against Betis. The ball is slipped through, and Raúl is away! Ricardo rushes out, and Raúl scoops it over him! Goal!

chapters.label: Stay cool
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Ricardo charges out. Raúl stays cool. He slips his left foot under the ball and lifts it softly over the keeper.

chapters.label: The Raulina
chapters.text: It drops into the empty net! A newspaper said this chip needed a name: the Raulina!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when the keeper rushes out, a gentle chip can be the best finish.
